display_long_description:
Welcome to SpeedPad. The fun Mixed Reality game that exercises your mind and body.  

🕹️ Based on scientific research from Psychology and Sports Science, SpeedPad aims to increase your reaction speed by improving your ability to orient attention and search for targets. 

🎯 Your mission? Hit each target that lights up as fast as you can.  But be aware.  Targets have a limited lifespan so every hit counts. Miss a target or hit the wrong pad, and your energy level drops.

💪 Explore different 4 gameplay modes. RampUp Mode with shrinking target lifespans, Time Mode with a countdown clock and Color Flip where its color based pads of your choosing. Try the Practice Mode for no-stress training.

🤝Challenge your buddies to friendly duels, compete for the highest scores and the longest sequences. It's exercise, bonding, and healthy competition rolled into one.

🌟 Train your eye-hand coordination and mental agility in captivating virtual environments. Or use in passthrough mode for an exciting Mixed Reality experience. Each theme feels like an epic adventure.
